exclusion_note: Derived from the first Czech 3000-surface harvest. Only three surfaces needed excluding: two subtitle release-group tags that retained zero usable sentences, and one English interjection. This list is deliberately tiny. 911 of 3000 Czech cards have no Wiktionary menu, but almost all are ordinary inflected Czech -- 'vstavej' is an imperative, not junk -- because English Wiktionary indexes lemmas while the frequency list is inflected forms. Excluding them would delete the language, not clean it. The menu gap is closed by lemma-aware lookup, not by exclusion.
